propositions: Jira issues moved between projects change their KEY but retain their immutable numeric ID, causing bindings keyed on the KEY to become stale and unresolvable if the moved_issue_key table is not updated by third-party movers.
The absence probe silently retires live issues by incorrectly treating stale keys as deletions, orphaning local tickets from issues that still exist.
The binding store must persist the numeric jira_id alongside the key and use it as a fallback when key lookup fails, re-keying the binding and updating the reverse index when a move is detected.
The remediation is additive to preserve Cloud vendor behavior and require no store migration, allowing pre-existing bindings without recorded IDs to degrade gracefully to current behavior.

On Jira DC 8.17.1, GET /rest/api/2/issue/{oldKey} returns HTTP 200 with the new key in the response body after a key rename, meaning the stale key resolves transparently through moved_issue_key until that table is not updated by a third-party mover.
